articles.title: Ex-West Bengal deputy speaker Ashis Banerjee found dead at TMC office
articles.description: Former deputy speaker of West Bengal Assembly, Ashis Banerjee, was found hanging at a TMC party office in Birbhum district on Sunday morning, police sources said. A purported suicide note was also recovered from the party office located near his residence in Hattala Para in Rampurhat, they said. Police reached the spot and sent the body for post-mortem examination. The exact circumstances leading to his death are yet to be ascertained, and police are examining the contents of the purported suicide note, the sources said. Banerjee, a veteran TMC leader, had represented Rampurhat in the state Assembly continuously from 2001 till 2026. He had served as the deputy speaker of the Assembly and held ministerial portfolios, including school education and agriculture, in the Mamata Banerjee government. articles.title: 'Want To Hide In Food Truck Again?': Iran Roasts Trump For Switching Planes After Hormuz Declaration
articles.description: Iran has fired back after U.S. President Donald Trump declared that the strategic Strait of Hormuz would become "America's territory." Senior Iranian lawmaker Ebrahim Azizi mocked Trump, warning that the U.S. president should worry about his own security instead of making threats over Hormuz. Azizi's remarks referenced reports that Trump secretly switched aircraft and allegedly used a catering truck as part of a high-security operation while leaving the NATO summit in Turkey amid an alleged Iranian assassination threat.
